g.text: Once per system, in this order. Each tool reads the real repos and proposes; the BA, an architect or the model's owners review
what it writes. Once the preflight passes, the agents can run.

g.text: Reviewed by: the BA (repos, GitLab, glossary, mappings), an architect (the catalog), the model's owners (its CONVENTIONS.md). No tool changes a repo it reads.
